selected_outcome: Primary Theorem4.7(2) coherent equivariant tilting factorization equivalence
decision: This general equivariant tilting-to-factorization equivalence is explicitly announced in the introduction and forms the main general result. One coherent equivalence outcome; abstract tilting, projectives/injectives, split descent, AppendixA and partial branch are shared support without extra counts. Pfaffian and specific NCCR applications are unselected.

evidence.exact_text: we generalize Okonek--Teleman's result to a $G$-equivariant setting. More precisely, we prove that $G$-equivariant tilting modules over $G$-equivariant algebras induce equivalences of derived factorization categories of noncommutative gauged LG models. Moreover, combining Rennemo--Segal's results in~\cite{rs} with our result, we prove that the derived category of a noncommutative resolution of a generic linear section of a Pfaffian variety is equivalent to the derived factorization category of a noncommutative gauged LG model $(\Lambda, \chi, w)^{\mathbb{G}_m}$, where $\Lambda$ is a non-commutative resolution of the quotient singularity $W/\GSp(Q)$ arising from a certain representation $W$ of the symplectic similitude group $\GSp(Q)$ of a symplectic vector space $Q$.
